_help: A-18: named unique quest rewards (scripts/Uniques.cs). Given by the story effect "unique": "<id>" (data/story.json: in a quest's rewards, or in a choice's "do" so each ending has its own) and by "unique" in an old quest's rw (data/quests.json). Each unique is given once per hero (flag unique:<id>), is never re-rolled by the smith, and shows its flavour text in the tooltip. oldQuest: the id of a quest in data/quests.json whose reward this is (given instead of its random item). Fields: n name, slot (weapon, shield, head, armor, hands, feet, trinket, cape), wt weapon class (weapons only; data/weapons.json), rar rarity 0-4 (name colour), minLvl the lowest item level it is made at (else the hero's level), base fixed stats {dmg, def, hp, mp, sp (spell power, 0.1 = 10%)}, per the same stats added per item level, mods the signature effect in stat keys (docs/STATS.md; statusChance, leech, thorns, form_<id> ...) and fixed, elem element (data/gear_fx.json: a weapon inflicts its status), glow hex glow colour, sockets gem sockets, flavour the text in the tooltip, from where it comes from (shown in the tooltip).

sealstone_aegis.flavour: Cut from the stone that closed the Rift. It still hums, but only when you listen for it.
sealstone_aegis.from: The Heart of the Rift: sealed

riftbinder.flavour: Ossian bound the Rift in a jar. This is what he bound it with. Do not ask what is in the knot.
riftbinder.from: The Heart of the Rift: bound

freefolk_edge.flavour: Forged from the melted tax seals of Cinderhold. Ashford answers to no lord, and neither does this.

cinderhold_plate.flavour: Lord Emrys had it made for the man who kept his banners flying. Heavy, like the order it kept.

shared_crown.flavour: Half keep-iron, half Ashford gold, and nobody is allowed to wear it for long.

bell_of_rest.flavour: It rang once, and a king's court lay down. It has not rung since. Wila sleeps.

drowned_crown.flavour: Raised from the silt with Mott. The bells ring louder when you wear it, and something of the king comes with it.

scale_of_merit.flavour: It came down on the side of the light. You tipped it.

viziers_signet.flavour: A gift for his most reasonable friend. Doors open for it. People step aside for it.

ashes_of_proof.flavour: A grey cloak that still smells of burnt paper. Nobody remembers seeing you in it.

yetibane.flavour: Wintermere's sentries stand easier since. The shaft is wrapped in the white hide of what hunted them.
yetibane.from: The White Hunger: the deed is yours

fennick_thanks.flavour: They call her Yeti-bane now. You both know better. She strung this herself.

open_shelf_codex.flavour: A fair copy of the cure, in Sylwen's hand. Three gardens saved already.

keepers_key.flavour: Thalorin's own. It opens one door, and what is behind that door stays behind it.

blue_steel.flavour: His daughter's blade, finished at last. Sigvald made a second from the same ore, and would not take coin for it.

white_fox_mantle.flavour: Oskar had the best of the furs made up for the one who would not be paid.

first_prize_gauntlets.flavour: FIRST. Look at the ribbon. Lorien riveted it on so you could not lose it.

greaves_of_hobb.flavour: Four years running. Plain, heavy, and they will outlast you.

kettle_charm.flavour: A scrap of kettle lid on a cord. The kettle is on. For you it is always on.
kettle_charm.from: Tea at the Edge of Fire

pells_snare.flavour: The snares came down. He kept one, and then gave you that too.
pells_snare.from: Snares in the Wood: you fed Pell

wolfsbane_cloak.flavour: Five grey pelts, stitched by Maren. Wear it long enough and the pack stops running from you.

riftstone_charm.flavour: A chip of the Whispering Stones. Warm in the Light, cold in the Shadow.

barrow_circlet.flavour: He used to be a good man, they say. The circlet remembers the other part.

grukks_cleaver.flavour: Notched on a hundred cart axles. The watch fund would not have covered it.

heart_of_ashes.flavour: The golem's core, still warm. The tremors stopped; it did not.

vorthrax_fang.flavour: One tooth of the Ashen Drake, set in a hilt. You are the legend now; this is the proof.

crowds_favour.flavour: Wraps thrown down from the stands after the fifth wave, still sticky with somebody's wine.

mirror_shard.flavour: What was left on the sand when your double fell. It moves a moment after you do.

champions_shadow.flavour: Three shadows beaten in a row, each stronger than the last. Kael had them sewn together.
